Boat-shaped khachapuri filled with molten cheese, a runny egg and butter stirred through at the table. Roll 500g pizza dough into 4 ovals, fill with 200g mozzarella mixed with 200g crumbled feta and fold the edges into boat shapes. Bake at 230C for 12 minutes, crack an egg into each and bake 4 minutes more. Add a knob of butter and stir at the table.

Soft yeasted buns stuffed with beef mince, onion, rice and dill, fried golden and served hot with sour cream for dipping. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt, 250ml warm milk and 1 egg into a soft dough and prove 1 hour. Fry 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion until browned, then stir in 100g cooked rice, 3 tbsp chopped dill, salt and pepper and cool. Divide the dough into 12, flatten, fill and pinch closed. Rest 15 minutes, then fry at 175C for 3 minutes a side. Serve with sour cream.
M: Danko's partner, who talks all the way through dinner

Strips of eye fillet seared fast and set aside, mushrooms and onion browned, paprika, mustard and stock reduced, sour cream stirred in off the heat, beef back in. Sear 600g eye fillet strips fast in batches and set aside. Brown 300g mushrooms and 1 onion, add 1 tsp paprika, 1 tbsp Dijon and 250ml stock and reduce. Stir in 200g sour cream off the heat, add the beef back. Serve over 400g egg noodles.
Ridzik's Chicago deep dish sausage pizza

Buttery cornmeal crust pressed up a deep tin, layered with mozzarella, Italian sausage and chunky tomato sauce, topped with parmesan and baked golden. Mix 350g plain flour, 50g cornmeal, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt, 60g melted butter and 230ml warm water, knead and prove 1 hour. Press into a greased 25cm deep tin, up the sides. Layer 250g sliced mozzarella, then 400g Italian sausage meat pressed into a flat layer. Simmer 400g crushed tomatoes with garlic and oregano for 10 minutes and spread on top. Scatter 40g grated parmesan and bake at 220C for 35 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.
W: Russian layers for the Soviet cop
Honey dough (honey, butter, sugar, eggs, bicarb, flour) rolled into thin discs, baked 6 minutes each, layered with sour cream and condensed milk cream, crumbs on the outside, rested overnight.
K: Danko's cranberry mors and vodka cooler
a taste of home for the Soviet cop

Russian-style mors of simmered cranberries, honey and lemon, chilled and poured over ice with vodka and soda, garnished with frozen berries. Simmer 300g frozen cranberries with 600ml water and 4 tbsp honey for 10 minutes, crushing the berries. Strain, add the juice of 1 lemon and chill. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 40ml vodka and 120ml mors to each, top with 60ml soda water and stir. Garnish with a few frozen cranberries and a lemon slice.

steps.text: Melt the honey, butter and sugar, then whisk in the eggs and bicarb, then the flour to a dough.
Roll the dough into thin discs.
Bake each disc, keeping the offcuts for crumbs, in a 180C oven.
Beat the sour cream with the condensed milk.
Layer the discs with the cream.
Crush the offcuts and coat the cake in the crumbs.
Rest the cake overnight in the fridge.
